Soybean___healthy.Environment: Warm temperatures (20–30°C), fertile well-drained loamy soil (pH 6.0–7.0), adequate sunlight and consistent soil moisture.
Soybean___healthy.Description: The uploaded soybean leaf shows no visible signs of disease, pest infestation or nutrient deficiency. The plant appears healthy and capable of normal vegetative growth, flowering and pod development under proper crop management.

Age_Cycle.Early: Healthy seedling emergence with bright green leaves.
Age_Cycle.Moderate: Normal vegetative growth, flowering and pod formation.
Age_Cycle.Estimated: Continuous healthy development throughout the crop growth cycle.

Organic_Treatment: Maintain fertile soil using compost or farmyard manure.
Apply biofertilizers such as Rhizobium inoculants.
Use organic mulch to conserve soil moisture.
Prevention: Keep the field free from weeds and crop residues.
Recommended_Actions: Monitor plants weekly for early disease or pest symptoms.
Continue current soybean crop management practices.
